system.description:
Category: Skill

You have begun to find some truth in the world of illusions and Genjutsu, finding its origins to be darker and more sinister than you once thought. You gain the following benefits:

Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in the Illusions skill. If you are already proficient, you instead gain Mastery.

Your Illusion skill actions gain the following benefits:.

Your Identify Genjutsu skill action is vs the jutsu’s Save DC, instead of its DC +5.

You can use Read the Enemy against a Genjutsu without seeing its hand seals.

The bonus for a successful Read the Enemy against a Genjutsu, becomes a +3 bonus to the triggering saving throw, instead of +1.

You reduce the DT needed to learn Genjutsu using any method by an amount equal to the rank of the jutsu, to a minimum of 1. (D-Rank: 1, C-Rank: 2, B-Rank: 3, A-Rank: 4, S-Rank: 5.)
